title: A page written in Markdown
lead: mdsvex compiles .svx to an ordinary Svelte component, so t() works inside it unchanged. What is worth spelling out is how such a route joins the loaders and the prerender.

component.title: It is just a component
component.text: By the time the router sees +page.svx it is a Svelte component. getContext and t() work exactly as they do in .svelte.

routes.title: It is just a route
routes.text: /guide matches a route-scoped loader like any other path. The namespace has no idea the page is Markdown.

prerender.title: It prerenders the same way
prerender.text: The entries under [lang] cover it, so the guide exists in every locale after a build.

note.title: Translating the prose is a separate decision
note.text: This example covers the component-level usage and the loading. Whether the Markdown itself gets one file per locale is a content question this library does not answer.
